title: Crossformer: Hierarchical attention narrows the horizon-720 gap versus horizon-336 for Crossformer on ETTh1, Traffic
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using Crossformer, a cross-dimension transformer with hierarchical encoder. On ETTh1, Traffic, at horizon 720, Hierarchical attention narrows the horizon-720 gap versus horizon-336 for Crossformer on ETTh1, Traffic. Crossformer MSE at horizon 720 is 28% below the closest transformer baseline on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Confidence intervals or standard errors are not reported for the headline metric. Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested. Future work should address combining channel-independent tokenisation with variate-token attention. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
